questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Boland or Warriors?
At which ground did Hlumelo Mati record their career-best bowling figures (2-1, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Bloemfontein Oval, against Knights on 2015/10/17.

questions.question: How many catches separate the all-time #1 (Nondumiso Shangase) and #2 (Tatum le Roux) fielders (T20)?
questions.explanation: Nondumiso Shangase: 29 — Tatum le Roux: 23 — a gap of 6.

questions.question: At Kimberley Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (T20)?
Who was the first South African woman to take a five-wicket haul in a T20I, achieving the feat before Shabnim Ismail became the second in 2018?
questions.explanation: Ismail's 5 for 30 against India in February 2018 made her the second South African to take a T20I five-wicket haul, after Sune Luus.

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Most 5-Wicket Hauls' in the 13/14 season (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Michelle du Preez holds it, with a total of 2, a joint record shared with Yolandi Potgieter, Maryka Kirchoff and Selaelo Mphahele.
